C0085.title: Douyin Streamer Detained for Cross-Platform Traffic Redirection to Overseas Accounts via VPN
C0085.summary: Douyin detected accounts that bought circumvention software, posted pornographic content on overseas social platforms, and redirected users to follow those overseas accounts. The platform disposed of the related accounts, preserved evidence, and assisted the authorities. Three users were placed under criminal detention, and the cases were still under further investigation.
